# Anne & Roy Gardner

- [Anne](../character/anne.md) — Romantically involved with — [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md) — courting college suitor · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Christine P4](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0004), [v3 ch.Christine P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 ch.Evening P22](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0022), +3 more</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) converses with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) at Patty's Place before deciding to take a walk in the park. Catch in a sudden rainstorm, [Anne](../character/anne.md) meets a handsome fellow [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) student named Royal Gardner, who rescues her with his umbrella and walks her home. Later that evening, [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) sends [Anne](../character/anne.md) a dozen roses, sparking excitement and romantic speculation among her housemates.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXV Enter Prince Charming

> While getting dressed for a [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) reception at Patty's Place, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) compliments [Anne](../character/anne.md) on her dress and mentions that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) has been seen frequently with [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) feels inexplicably bothered by the news and travels to the reception with [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md). Upon arriving, [Anne](../character/anne.md) notices [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) across the room talking to the beautiful Christine and quietly compares her own appearance to hers.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXVI Enter Christine

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) joins [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. Rachel, [Dora](../character/dora.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) outside on a June evening. [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) complains about his schoolwork and the local funerals, but [Anne](../character/anne.md) offers to help him with his arithmetic. The conversation turns to local gossip, including Diana's upcoming wedding to [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) and the town's reaction to [Anne](../character/anne.md) rejecting [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) later wanders down to Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble), feeling melancholic about Gilbert's absence and the changes that growing up brings.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXVIII A June Evening

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and her friends reflect on what they have learned at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) as their examinations finish up. On [Convocation](../codex/places.md#convocation) day, [Anne](../character/anne.md) chooses Gilbert's lilies over Roy's violets to carry, but later learns of a rumor about Gilbert's engagement to [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md), leading her to secretly break the chain [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) gave her. After attending the graduation dance, the girls unwind back at Patty's Place while [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) mentions a visitor.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVII Full-fledged B.A.’s

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) feeling a sense of disappointment and loneliness following her rejection of [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md). She learns local gossip from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), hears news of friends' engagements and marriages, visits Diana's new baby, and attends Phil's wedding.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXIX Deals with Weddings

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) from [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and learns from her family that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is critically ill with typhoid fever. Keeping a stormy night watch in her room, [Anne](../character/anne.md) realizes she has always loved [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and despairs over her foolishness. In the morning, she meets [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md) Buote in the yard and learns that Gilbert's fever has broken and he will recover.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XL A Book of Revelation

> [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) asks [Anne](../character/anne.md) to go for a walk, but she must prepare for Alice Penhallow's wedding. The next afternoon, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) walk to [Hester](../character/hester-gray.md) Gray's garden where [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) proposes to her again. [Anne](../character/anne.md) accepts, and they share their mutual feelings and clarify past misunderstandings before walking home engaged.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XLI Love Takes Up the Glass of Time

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) spend autumn evenings visiting Captain Jim at the lighthouse, often accompanied by [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md). On their walk home, they discuss Leslie's wasted potential before turning to affectionate teaseing about Anne's past suitor and their shared joy in their own home.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS
